# ankra_object_storage_buckets (Data Source)

Lists the object-storage buckets Ankra created in the provider's project, newest first. Keys are never listed. The counterpart of `ankra bucket list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_object_storage_buckets" "all" {}

output "bucket_endpoints" {
  value = { for bucket in data.ankra_object_storage_buckets.all.buckets : bucket.name => bucket.endpoint }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) Buckets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) Bucket name on the provider.
- `credential_id` (String) Credential the bucket was created with.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the bucket.
- `name` (String) Name in Ankra.
- `path_style` (Boolean) Whether the bucket is addressed path-style.
- `provider` (String) Provider the bucket lives on.
- `region` (String) Provider region.
- `status` (String) `provisioning`, `ready` or `error`.
